integrity: The two-sided oblique tangent projector is credited to Carrel and Grigori (2026). The exact difference norm, sharp norm-embedding transfer and equality constructions are the claims assessed here. No independent scientific validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Instantaneous exact-arithmetic rank-r tangent projection; no whole-trajectory, stochastic probability, or finite-precision assertion. The residual-specific combined subspace embedding condition is essential. A structurally similar formula may appear in earlier oblique projection literature and has not been independently excluded.
title: Sharp normal-to-tangent leakage for two-sided sketched low-rank projections
